findings.description: The previous summarize() materialised the batch and loaded each sensor's calibration once. The new loop calls calibrated(), which calls source.load() for every reading. With a SQL-backed CalibrationSource this issues one query per reading, so a large batch causes N+1 queries and noticeably slower runs for the same result.
findings.suggestion: Cache calibrations per sensor_id within summarize(), for example with a dict filled lazily from source.load(), and apply the cached calibration in the loop. Keep the streaming loop if that matters, since the cache only holds one Calibration per sensor.
findings.title: Calibration is now loaded once per reading instead of once per sensor
